name: selfhst-icons
description: selfh.st/icons is a collection of logos and icons for for self-hosted (and non-self-hosted) software. This is a container to reference and colorize selfh.st/icons via HEX color codes. See here for how to use the custom colored icons. https://github.com/selfhst/icons/wiki#building-links Example Usage https://example.com/bookstack https://example.com/bookstack/primary https://example.com/bookstack/8803fc https://example.com/custom/bookstack.png The image is configured to reference remote icon files by default. Users who prefer to host the assets locally should consider one of the following options (not covered in this documentation): - rsync - Cloning the repository to a local folder - External tools like git-sync A self-hosting guide can be seen here: https://github.com/sceather/Unraid-templates/wiki/selfh.st-icons

variables.name: ICON_SOURCE
variables.description: # Set to 'remote' to use remote assets from this repo # Set to 'local' to use local icon files (requires volume mount)

variables.name: STANDARD_ICON_FORMAT
variables.description: # Specify an icon format to use when a custom color is not specified # By default, this is set to 'webp' as not all icons have SVG versions

variables.name: PRIMARY_COLOR
variables.description: # Specify a primary custom icon color to easily apply or update icons in bulk # Note: See the 'Building Links' section below for how to reference the primary color in URLs

variables.name: REMOTE_URL
variables.description: # Specify a remote URL to serve icons from somewhere other than this repository # Note: The URL must serve paths for /svg and the STANDARD_ICON_FORMAT below from its root
